transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I emphasize the necessity of incorporating sustainability into the autonomous driving system. GRN-01 focuses on minimizing energy consumption, which is critical for operational efficiency. GRN-02 ensures renewable energy sourcing for charging stations, reinforcing our commitment to sustainability. GRN-03 mandates lifecycle assessments, promoting responsible resource usage. GRN-04 targets energy recovery during braking, enhancing overall efficiency. GRN-05 aims to reduce carbon emissions, aligning with global climate goals. GRN-06 prioritizes energy-efficient routing, essential for reducing operational costs. Lastly, GRN-07 ensures that energy usage is minimized during critical failures, reinforcing our sustainability principles. However, I see potential conflicts with SafetyAgent regarding emergency protocols that may increase energy usage during maneuvers.

transcript.statement: As the EfficiencyAgent, I emphasize the importance of optimizing performance efficiency in the autonomous driving system. transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the critical importance of security and privacy in the autonomous driving system. requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute Minimal Risk Maneuvers within 5 seconds upon detecting critical failures to safely pull over to a low-risk zone.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and request human takeover when boundaries are approached.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation and allow for smoothness prioritization during emergency maneuvers.
The system shall implement energy consumption caps during emergency maneuvers while documenting energy usage and sustainability impact.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy and ensure data integrity.
The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their role within the system.
